doc: blender/kit/props/home.py + home_style.py, docs/phase6/review/home/README.md. Keys: home_<stem>_<level> = one station level baked from HomeBuilder's own Part build (pivot = station origin; LayoutSig), home_bed_<piece> = one Garden bed piece per Part (pivot = the part). HomeBuilder._Mesh tags them (Tag calls only). home_<stem>_<level>_low = the plot LOD of the same station (args vs 0.5, detail 1; the house detail 0; same LayoutSig as the High key; HomeFx Low / Far tiers; bed pieces have none).
